description: This file contains unit tests for performance testing classes and methods in the webkitpy project, including tests for PerfTest, PerfTestMetric, SingleProcessPerfTest, and the PerfTestFactory, with focus on output parsing, metrics, and test creation logic.

classes.description: A mock subclass of TestPort for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestSingleProcessPerfTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SingleProcessPerfTest, verifying single process execution.

classes.name: TestPerfTestFactory
